title: On principal eigenpairs for the (p,q)-Laplacian in exterior domain
summary: We consider an eigenvalue problem of the form \begin{equation*} \left\{\begin{array}{rclll} -Δ_{p} u -Δ_{q} u&=& λK(x)|u|^{p-2}u & \mbox{ in } Ω^e u&=&0\qquad \quad &\mbox{ on } \partial Ω u(x) &\to& 0 &\mbox{ as } |x| \to \infty\,, \end{array}\right. \end{equation*} where $Ω^e$ is the exterior of a simply connected, bounded domain $Ω$ in $\mathbb{R}^N$, $p, q \in (1, N)$ with $p \neq q$, $0 < K \in L^{\infty}(Ω^e) \cap L^{\frac{N}{p}}(Ω^e)$, and $λ\in \mathbb{R}$.
